name: Epoch 39 - Loss of Control and Fracture

pages.text: I was wrong.$(br2)That day I meant to drive the rainfall to its full radius, and cast every crystal I had saved for three years into the furnace's heart. By the ninth cycle the light at the core had become a colour I did not recognise - not blue, not white, but a flowing thing, like an open wound.

pages.title: In My Mother's Voice
pages.text: The wind came from within the furnace and called my name in my mother's voice.$(br2)I tried to pull the crystals out, but my hands would not obey. The whole altar shook, and the sky, like a cloth wrung dry, was twisted into a hole.

pages.title: The Climate Shard
pages.text: Lightning fell from the sky and shattered the core with a thunderclap. Out of the breaking came a single cold fragment.$(br2)I pocketed it and named it the $(item)Climate Shard$() - neither cold nor warm, only quietly remembering that disaster.$(br2)I had a suspicion it could tear open something larger than a crack.
